title: 便携式发电机安全使用
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/07_Generator Safety Portable Generator Hazards And Precautions Electric Generator S.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/07_Generator Safety Portable Generator Hazards And Precautions Electric Generator S/src.py

points.K5: 电器直接插在发电机上
points.K11: 保持干燥，必要时加遮篷
points.K14: 不在室内和封闭空间用
points.K15: 四周上方留空，通风良好
points.K17: 中毒症状：马上到新鲜空气处
points.K18: 发动机烫，燃油遇热会着火
points.K24: 噪声振动伤听力、致疲劳
points.K25: 发电机远离工作和聚集区

shots.scene: 欣欣站在校园草坪边一台小型便携式发电机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a small portable generator on the edge of a campus lawn and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲便携式发电机的安全使用。
overlay: 便携式发电机安全使用

shots.scene: 闪电、一氧化碳云、火焰、耳朵四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a lightning bolt, a grey exhaust cloud, a flame and an ear. No people.
shots.narration: 触电、中毒、起火、噪声，一个个说。

shots.scene: 野外实习营地，阿杰把发电机搬进帐篷门口，旁边下着小雨
shots.prompt_en: At a field trip campsite in light rain, the young male student drags a portable generator into the doorway of a tent.
shots.narration: 野外实习下起雨，阿杰想把发电机搬进帐篷。

shots.scene: 帐篷里的发电机冒出灰色烟雾的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator inside a tent with a grey exhaust cloud filling it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 在帐篷里开发电机，废气会把人熏倒。

shots.scene: 小研快步上前拦住阿杰，指向营地外的空地
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over, stops the young male student and points to an open area away from the tents.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧拦住：放到外面空地上去！

shots.scene: 欣欣撑着伞站在发电机旁，举起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds an umbrella beside the generator and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 发电机很方便，用错了却很危险。

shots.scene: 发电机剖面图标：左边发动机，右边发电部分，电线连到灯泡
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway icon of a portable generator, an engine on one side and a power unit on the other, with a cable to a glowing bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 便携式发电机里有一台内燃机。

shots.scene: 燃油滴、齿轮、闪电三个图标用箭头连起来
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked by arrows: a fuel drop, a turning gear and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 烧油带动发电，送出电来。

shots.scene: 野外帐篷、户外舞台、停电的楼三个图标，都接着一台发电机
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each connected to a small generator: a field tent, an outdoor stage and a dark building with a power outage. No people.
shots.narration: 野外、临时活动、停电时都用得上。

shots.scene: 发电机图标上方出现黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A portable generator icon with a yellow warning triangle above it. No people.
shots.narration: 但它同时带着好几种危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着白板，白板上四个空白格子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a whiteboard divided into four blank boxes.
shots.narration: 发电机的危害，主要有四类。

shots.scene: 插头和闪电图标，一根线连到房屋图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plug with a lightning bolt, and a wire leading back into a house icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用电不当会触电，还可能电到别处。

shots.scene: 发电机排气口冒出灰色云团图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator exhaust pipe releasing a grey cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 排出的废气里有一氧化碳。

shots.scene: 油桶和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fuel can next to a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 加油、存油不当，容易起火。

shots.scene: 耳朵图标和振动波纹
shots.prompt_en: An ear icon with vibration wave lines beside a generator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有持续的噪声和振动。

shots.scene: 发电机电线直接接进墙上配电箱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator cable wired straight into a wall distribution box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能把发电机直接接进楼里的线路。

shots.scene: 电流箭头从配电箱倒流到外面电线杆的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of current arrows flowing backward from a building panel out to a utility pole. No people.
shots.narration: 电会倒送出去，危及检修线路的人。

shots.scene: 老李在配电箱旁安装一个空白的切换开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a blank changeover switch box next to a distribution panel.
shots.narration: 要接，须由合格电工装切换开关。

shots.section_title: 电器直接插在发电机上
shots.scene: 台灯的插头直接插在发电机面板插座上
shots.prompt_en: A desk lamp's plug inserted directly into the socket panel of a portable generator.
shots.narration: 用电器直接插在发电机插座上。
overlay: 电器直接插在发电机上

shots.section_title: 电器直接插在发电机上
shots.scene: 随机电源线和带接地脚的三芯插头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an original supplied power cord and a three-prong grounded plug. No people.
shots.narration: 用随机的线，或带接地的三芯延长线。

shots.scene: 阿杰双手捋过一根延长线，仔细查看外皮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student runs an extension cord through both hands, carefully checking its outer jacket.
shots.narration: 插线之前，先把电线检查一遍。

shots.scene: 外皮割破、磨损的电线图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an extension cord with a cut and worn jacket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 破损、割伤、磨损的线，一律不用。

shots.scene: 电线标签图标和用电器图标，中间是等号
shots.prompt_en: A blank cord rating tag icon and an appliance icon with an equals sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 电线额定功率要配得上用电器。

shots.scene: 细电线被换成粗电线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thin cord being swapped out for a thicker cord with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 额定值不够的线，换成合格的。

shots.scene: 发电机插满插头，机身发红冒热气的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator with every socket filled and the body glowing red with heat lines. No people.
shots.narration: 插得太多会过载，机器发热。

shots.scene: 过热的发电机旁冒出火苗，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an overheated generator with a small flame beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 过热就可能引发火灾。

shots.scene: 发电机输出端串着一个带试验按钮的漏电保护器图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a residual current protection device with a test button connected at the generator outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 输出端要配漏电保护器。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器跳闸、闪电被挡住的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a residual current device tripping and a shield blocking a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 一有漏电，它会马上断开。

shots.scene: 老李把接地线拧紧在发电机的接地端子上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens a green and yellow ground wire onto the grounding terminal of the generator.
shots.narration: 发电机要接地良好，接头拧紧。

shots.scene: 老李对照空白说明书核对
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks against a blank instruction manual held open beside the generator.
shots.narration: 怎么接地，按说明书来做。

shots.section_title: 保持干燥，必要时加遮篷
shots.scene: 雨中淋湿的发电机图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator standing in the rain getting wet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 下雨和潮湿时，不要露天使用。
overlay: 保持干燥，必要时加遮篷

shots.section_title: 保持干燥，必要时加遮篷
shots.scene: 发电机放在开放式遮篷下，四面通风
shots.prompt_en: A portable generator sits under an open-sided canopy on dry ground, with open air all around.
shots.narration: 确实要用，就搭个四面通风的遮篷。

shots.scene: 湿手伸向发电机开关的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dripping wet hand reaching for a generator switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手湿、身上湿，别碰电气部件。

shots.scene: 脚站在水坑里的图标，旁边是发电机，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boots standing in a puddle next to a generator control panel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 站在积水里，也不能去操作。

shots.scene: 泡在水里的电器图标，挂着禁止使用的牌
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electrical appliance sitting in floodwater with a blank do-not-use tag hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 泡过水的电气设备，不能直接用。

shots.scene: 老李擦干设备，用空白检测仪检查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer dries an appliance with a cloth and checks it with a blank electrical tester.
shots.narration: 彻底干燥、检查合格后再用。

shots.section_title: 不在室内和封闭空间用
shots.scene: 车库、帐篷、地下室三个图标，里面各有发电机，全部打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a garage, a tent and a basement, each with a generator inside, all crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 室内和封闭空间里，不能开发电机。
overlay: 不在室内和封闭空间用

shots.section_title: 不在室内和封闭空间用
shots.scene: 封闭房间里灰色废气越积越多的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a closed room slowly filling with grey exhaust. No people.
shots.narration: 一氧化碳会越积越多，令人中毒。

shots.section_title: 四周上方留空，通风良好
shots.scene: 空地上的发电机四周和上方都有空白的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A portable generator on open ground with blank arrows showing clear space on all sides and above it. No people.
shots.narration: 四周和上方都要留足空间。
overlay: 四周上方留空，通风良好

shots.section_title: 四周上方留空，通风良好
shots.scene: 欣欣把堆在发电机旁的纸箱搬开
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot moves cardboard boxes away from the sides of a portable generator.
shots.narration: 别堆东西，保证空气流通。

shots.scene: 发电机放在窗户下、废气飘进窗内的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator placed under an open window with exhaust drifting inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 就算在室外，也别挨着门窗。

shots.scene: 发电机远离楼房、排气口朝外的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator placed far from a building with the exhaust pointing away, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 废气会从门窗、风口钻进屋里。

shots.section_title: 中毒症状：马上到新鲜空气处
shots.scene: 阿杰扶着头，表情难受，旁边是头晕、头痛、恶心图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his head looking dizzy and unwell, with icons of a spinning head and a stomach beside him.
shots.narration: 头晕、头痛、恶心、乏力要警惕。
overlay: 中毒症状：马上到新鲜空气处

shots.section_title: 中毒症状：马上到新鲜空气处
shots.scene: 小研扶阿杰走到户外开阔处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student walk out into fresh open air.
shots.narration: 马上离开，到空气新鲜的地方。

shots.section_title: 中毒症状：马上到新鲜空气处
shots.scene: 医院红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 及时就医，不能硬扛。

shots.section_title: 中毒症状：马上到新鲜空气处
shots.scene: 门口拉着警戒带，保卫处值班员站在旁边
shots.prompt_en: A doorway blocked with a blank barrier tape, with the security officer standing beside it.
shots.narration: 专业人员确认安全前，别再进去。

shots.section_title: 发动机烫，燃油遇热会着火
shots.scene: 发电机发动机部位发红的热度图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a generator with its engine area glowing red with heat lines. No people.
shots.narration: 发电机运转时很烫，停机后还烫。
overlay: 发动机烫，燃油遇热会着火

shots.section_title: 发动机烫，燃油遇热会着火
shots.scene: 油滴落到热发动机上冒出火苗的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fuel drop falling onto a hot engine part and catching a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 燃油洒到热部件上，就会着火。

shots.scene: 老李按下发电机停机开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the stop switch on the portable generator.
shots.narration: 加油前，先把发电机停下来。

shots.scene: 发电机旁的时钟图标，热度线渐渐消失
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a clock next to a generator whose heat lines fade away. No people.
shots.narration: 等它冷却了，再慢慢加油。

shots.scene: 运转中的发电机加油的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fuel can pouring into a running generator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 运转时加油，绝对不行。

shots.scene: 带盖、带标识的合格油桶图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an approved fuel container with a sealed cap, a vent and a blank content label. No people.
shots.narration: 燃油装在合格的专用容器里。

shots.scene: 饮料瓶装油的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drink bottle filled with fuel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标明装的是什么，别用饮料瓶。

shots.scene: 油桶与发电机、热水器、香烟、打火机、火柴之间画着隔开的线
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fuel can separated by a dividing line from a generator, a water heater, a cigarette, a lighter and matches. No people.
shots.narration: 油桶远离发电机和各种热源。

shots.scene: 香烟、打火机、火柴图标逐个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cigarette, a lighter and a box of matches, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 香烟、打火机、火柴都要远离。

shots.scene: 油桶旁贴着禁止吸烟标志
shots.prompt_en: A fuel can next to a no smoking sign. No people.
shots.narration: 存油的地方，严禁吸烟。

shots.scene: 宿舍楼图标里放着油桶，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fuel can inside a dormitory building, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 燃油不放在住的地方。

shots.scene: 油桶放在远离住处的单独存放点图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fuel can stored in a separate small outdoor storage spot far from living quarters. No people.
shots.narration: 要放在远离生活区的地方。

shots.section_title: 噪声振动伤听力、致疲劳
shots.scene: 发电机旁的振动波纹和噪声波纹图标
shots.prompt_en: A portable generator icon surrounded by noise and vibration wave lines. No people.
shots.narration: 发电机一开，又吵又震。
overlay: 噪声振动伤听力、致疲劳

shots.section_title: 噪声振动伤听力、致疲劳
shots.scene: 耳朵图标带红色波纹，旁边疲惫的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: An ear icon with red sound waves and a tired person pictogram slumping beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 久了伤听力，人也容易疲劳。

shots.section_title: 发电机远离工作和聚集区
shots.scene: 发电机放在离帐篷和桌椅很远的地方，中间画着距离箭头
shots.prompt_en: A portable generator placed far from tents and a seating area, with a long distance arrow between them.
shots.narration: 发电机尽量远离工作和人多的地方。
overlay: 发电机远离工作和聚集区

shots.scene: 老李戴上耳罩靠近发电机
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on earmuffs before walking up to the running generator.
shots.narration: 离不开的话，就戴耳塞或耳罩。

shots.scene: 耳塞和耳罩图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of foam earplugs and earmuffs with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 听力保护好，干活也更清醒。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白申请表上签字，阿杰在旁边等候
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank application form while the young male student waits beside the desk.
shots.narration: 校内外活动要用发电机，先报备。

shots.scene: 老李给发电机接线，阿杰站在一旁看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer connects cables to the generator while the young male student watches from a step back.
shots.narration: 接线由持证电工来，学生不动手。

shots.scene: 发电机旁挂着空白的责任人牌
shots.prompt_en: A portable generator with a blank responsible-person tag hanging on its handle. No people.
shots.narration: 指定专人管理，运行时有人照看。

shots.scene: 发电机附近的值班帐篷里挂着一氧化碳报警器图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a carbon monoxide alarm mounted inside a nearby duty tent. No people.
shots.narration: 一氧化碳无色无味，鼻子闻不出来。

shots.scene: 报警器闪红灯，小研带大家撤到户外
shots.prompt_en: A carbon monoxide alarm flashes red, and the female graduate student leads the young male student outside.
shots.narration: 报警器一响，立刻撤离、通风。

shots.scene: 汽油桶贴着易燃液体警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A fuel can with a flammable liquid warning sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 汽油是易燃液体，属危险化学品。

shots.scene: 少量油桶放进专用安全柜，柜门关好
shots.prompt_en: A small fuel can placed inside a dedicated flammable storage cabinet, the cabinet door then closed. No people.
shots.narration: 少量存放，放在专门的地方。

shots.scene: 实验室和宿舍图标里的油桶，都被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuel can inside a laboratory and inside a dormitory, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不得放在实验室和宿舍里。

shots.scene: 往燃油火上泼水的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being thrown onto a burning fuel fire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 燃油着火，不能用水浇。

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器和二氧化碳灭火器、灭火毯图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dry powder fire extinguisher, a carbon dioxide extinguisher and a fire blanket with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 用干粉、二氧化碳灭火器或灭火毯。

shots.scene: 电话图标上写着火警号码
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a flame icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 火势大就撤离，立即拨打119。

shots.scene: 门口的人想冲进充满灰烟的房间，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person running into a room full of grey exhaust, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有人中毒，别贸然冲进去救。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员关停发电机，打开门窗通风
shots.prompt_en: The security officer switches off the generator from outside and props the doors and windows open.
shots.narration: 先停机通风，由有防护的人施救。

shots.scene: 电话和红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 把人移到新鲜空气处，拨打120。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白记录本上登记，旁边有学院和保卫处图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes in a blank incident logbook, with icons of a department building and a security office beside it.
shots.narration: 报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，板上是插头、漏电保护器、接地图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard showing icons of a plug, a residual current device and a ground symbol.
shots.narration: 防触电：不乱接、线合格、有漏保。

shots.scene: 空地上的发电机，远离门窗和帐篷
